title: DeepSeek nears $12B funding round led by Tencent and CATL before HK IPO
summary: DeepSeek is finalising at least $12B (80B yuan) with Tencent and CATL among backers, ahead of a Hong Kong IPO targeted for Q1 2027; revenue run rate passed $1B in September.
reason: Strengthens a non-US challenger lab, diluting US frontier concentration.

title: Mistral previews 1T-parameter open-weight Large 4 'Le Chonk'
summary: France's Mistral AI unveiled Mistral Large 4, a 1-trillion-parameter model it plans to release with open weights, posting strong benchmark scores.
reason: Strong European open-weights model; weights promised, not yet released.

title: Google signs 3.6 GW power deal with Constellation incl. 890 MW new nuclear
summary: Google entered a 3.6 GW long-term power agreement with Constellation Energy, including 890 MW of new nuclear capacity from reactor uprates on the PJM grid, to feed AI data centers.
reason: Large energy deal enabling compute growth.

title: Sub-$100 phone shipments fall ~60% as AI data centers absorb memory supply
summary: Rest of World reported Q2 sub-$100 phone shipments fell nearly 60% year on year with prices up ~25%, hitting India (+21%) and Asia-Pacific hardest as memory makers divert supply to AI.
reason: AI buildout measurably pricing low-income users out of devices in the Global South.

title: Memphis data-center moratorium vote postponed amid protests and a fistfight
summary: The Memphis City Council postponed a data-center moratorium vote for a second time after more than 100 residents protested and a fight broke out; the vote moved to Oct 20.
